newsitem.title: LATVIA: RTF down again as Latvian shares fall.
newsitem.headline: RTF down again as Latvian shares fall.

text.p: Most Latvian shares prices were lower on Monday and volume was also down, dealers said.
Total turnover was at 84,000 lats versus 92,000 lats and the Rietumu index closed down 1.82 percent to 184.61.
"The downward tendency is unfortunately still persisting and it is Monday, usually a slow day, in addition," said Artur Shveds, a dealer with Saules Bank.
Riga Transport Fleet was the most active share at 30,400 lats, as it fell again, hitting 1.20 lats after 1.23 lats.
Daugavpils Chain maker had volume of 18,400 lats as it slipped five santimes to 2.60 lats.
Official list share Unibanka was also down to 3.68 lats from 3.75 lats on trade of 12,000 lats while fellow Staburadze remained stable at 2.64 on a tiny volume of 300 lats.
Secondary list share, the Valmiera Glassfibre, fell four santimes to 1.70 lats and traded 4,800 lats.
"Valmiera is coming closer to its real price and it could go down more as sellers outnumber buyers four times," Shveds said.
Rigas Raugs yeast factory which was down to 3.89 lats from 3.91 lats on volume of 3,900 lats and Kaija fish cannery, which fell eight santimes to 2.41 lats on turn over of 3,600 lats.
Riga Agriculture Machine maker saw trade of 3,200 lats and it slipped two santimes to 0.28 santimes.
Mangali Shipyard gained ground, adding four santimes to 1.29 lats as it traded 2,900 lats of shares.
